# Sona 1.6.1

A tag editor, fairer play counts, updates that find you - and a quarter of the size.

## 🏷️ Tag editor

- **Edit a track's tags** from its menu. Its best match from Deezer and iTunes is looked up as the editor opens, and **applied in one press**; every tag stays editable by hand.
- **Search again** with your own artist and title, and narrow the matches to one catalogue.
- **Choose its cover** from every match's artwork, or **add one from your gallery**.
- **Lyrics from five sources** at once - LrcLib, KuGou, BetterLyrics, YouLyPlus and Unison - each showing **whether it was synced to a recording as long as your track**, so synced lyrics line up.

## 🎵 Listening

- A track counts towards **Most played** once **80% of it has been played**, rather than after 10 seconds, and skipping ahead does not count. Plays started from a headset, the notification or another app count too.
- **Recent** lists a track once it actually plays, not when the queue is restored as the app opens.
- **Japanese lyrics romanization** downloads its dictionary (13 MB) once, from Settings › Lyrics. If you had it on, turn it on again there.

## ✨ Feel

- Lists **stretch past their ends** and spring back.
- **Every section folds away** at a press on its heading, smoothly, and a heading held at the top is underlined while its rows scroll beneath it.
- **Rescanning the library** shows its progress in a notification, and says when it is done.
- Messages no longer queue up; a new one **replaces the last**.

## ⬆️ Updates

- A new release is **found as soon as it is out**, and a check that failed offline is **made again the moment you are back online**.
- A newer version is offered **on whatever screen is open**, not only the library.

## 📦 Smaller

- Sona is now a **5 MB download instead of 20 MB**: the Japanese dictionary is downloaded only by those who use it, and the app reads in English throughout.
- Sona **no longer asks for access to music** when it already has access to all files.
